description: Source code for parsing and processing bytecode in PyTorch's JIT mobile module, including functions for instruction parsing, upgrading, and constants handling.

classes.name: OpCodeCache
classes.description: Caches parsed OpCodes to optimize bytecode parsing.

methods.name: expect_field
methods.description: Validates and extracts a field from a tuple of elements based on expected name.

methods.name: applyUpgrader
methods.description: Upgrades bytecode instructions based on operator version, replacing certain instructions with upgraded versions.

methods.name: parseInstructions
methods.description: Parses a list of instruction tuples into a mobile::Function object, optionally including debug info.

methods.name: parseConstants
methods.description: Adds constants to a mobile::Function object from a list of constants.

methods.name: parseTypes
methods.description: Parses type strings and appends corresponding type objects to a mobile::Function.

methods.name: parseRegisterSize
methods.description: Sets the register size for a mobile::Function.
